looks.blurb: Frosted glass panels float over a slow-drifting pastel aurora (periwinkle/lavender/mint). The orb is a 3-stop radial gradient sphere with a specular highlight and feathered bloom halo; idle breathes at 4s ease, listening ripples outward in mint, thinking hue-rotates, speaking pulses rhythmically. CSS backdrop-blur(24px) on every surface, 22px radii, 1px translucent white hairlines throughout.

True-black (#000) OLED canvas with electric cyan (#00E5FF) and magenta (#FF3DCB) accents. The orb is a canvas-rendered particle/bar-field — idle shows sparse rotating particles, listening renders a 32-bar spectrum reacting to a synthetic mic level in cyan, thinking shows a fast-orbiting magenta+cyan particle churn, speaking switches bars to acid-lime (#B6FF3D). Monospace labels, 6-8px radii, neon hairline glow borders, and scanline overlay.

Cream (#F6F1E7) background with serif display type (Palatino/Georgia), thin hairline rules, and a warm clay accent (#C8643C). The canvas orb renders as an organic blob — idle breathes with a slow scale, listening stretches with voice amplitude, thinking hue-cycles with an ink-bleed shimmer, speaking adds a flowing left-to-right stroke. Minimal shadow, open whitespace, italic captions, pill chips in cream.

Apple-style system UI: #F2F2F7 grouped background, white card surfaces, 0.5px separators, SF Pro type. The canvas orb is a Siri-style multi-hue gradient sphere — idle is blue-dominant, listening shifts to cyan+blue with amplitude rings, thinking hue-cycles across blue/teal/indigo, speaking turns green-dominant. iOS spring easing (cubic-bezier .32,.72,0,1), a live clock in the status bar, no-visible-scrollbar log.

Bone (#F4F2EC) background, 2px solid black borders everywhere, zero border-radius, hard 4px offset box-shadows. The orb is a bordered square containing a canvas-rendered monospace waveform: idle shows block-character bars (▁▂▃▄) with a blinking underscore cursor, listening and speaking render discrete rectangular bars in blue/orange, thinking renders a spinning ASCII glyph (|/—\) with PROCESSING text. All labels are uppercase monospace with bracket notation like [LISTENING] and [INT!].

Frosted glass panels float over a slow-drifting pastel aurora. The avatar is a blurred radial orb (periwinkle→lavender→mint) with a specular highlight and a double halo ring. All four states are driven by CSS keyframes and JS amplitude: idle breathing, listening bars + orb scale, thinking hue-rotate, speaking rhythmic bloom. Caption box slides to the top when screen-share is toggled; the orb shrinks to a corner with a cubic-bezier spring. UI uses backdrop-blur(24px) pill buttons and 22px radii throughout.

True-black OLED cockpit with 24 rotating spectrum bars around a cyan point-cloud orb. Listening drives both the bars and a core glow bloom; thinking switches to magenta churn with hue drift; speaking fires a fast speakBloom keyframe. A monospace HUD header shows a live clock. The caption box has a gradient hairline top edge and a pulsing dot indicator. Screen-share toggle snaps the avatar to the corner at 220ms via the OLED ease curve. All colors reference only CSS tokens.

Cream serif layout with an animated SVG ink-stroke behind a clay/terracotta CSS blob that morphs its border-radius between states. Idle breathing uses gentle clayBreathe keyframes; listening stretches and contracts the blob organically; thinking desaturates to amber; speaking flows left-to-right in cadence. Caption uses Iowan Old Style serif at 15px/1.65 line-height. All transitions are 500–600ms ease-in-out. Chips are quiet pill outlines. Feels like a literary companion, not a tech product.

iOS-native system UI: white surfaces, 0.5px hairline separators, SF Pro Text. The avatar is a clean blue gradient orb (Gemini/Siri-inspired) with a ripple ring that animates on listening. An inset frame-glow on the app border reinforces the listening and speaking states. Transcript renders iMessage-style bubbles (user = blue filled, assistant = white outlined). The demo cycle uses 250–350ms iOS spring easing. Status bar shows live time and battery/wifi glyphs. Caption slides to top when feed appears with a clean spring reflow.

Hard-edge monospace terminal UI with zero border-radius. The avatar is a bordered box containing animated Unicode block characters (▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█) that step through states without easing — a blinking █ cursor for idle, rising block bars for listening, a rotating | / - \ spinner for thinking, and reactive bars for speaking. All state changes are step-function instant. Caption text streams character-by-character at typewriter speed. An inverted black header bar shows ELIZA.EXE and the current state in uppercase. Hover on any element inverts colors immediately.

Frosted glass panels over a slow-drifting pastel aurora background. Periwinkle-to-lavender gradient orb breathes with CSS keyframe animation across all 4 states. Waveform bars in the dock animate with JS timers. All surfaces use backdrop-filter blur and translucent white hairline borders. Aurora background animates on a 30s loop.

True-black OLED cockpit with electric cyan and magenta neon. Orb, header avatar, and empty-state avatar all rendered on Canvas: idle = rotating particle field, listening = amplitude-reactive spectrum bars (cyan), thinking = magenta inner churn, speaking = alternating cyan/magenta bars reacting to TTS envelope. Scanline shimmer overlay via CSS repeating-gradient. All labels in uppercase monospace with neon text-shadow glows.

Cream serif editorial look inspired by Pi/Claude document threads. Avatar is a hand-drawn-feeling ink stroke on Canvas: idle = gentle undulation, listening = stretches with mic amplitude, thinking = rotating petal ink-bleed shimmer, speaking = flowing harmonic left-to-right stroke. Assistant bubbles use a left border-rule instead of a filled box. Serif body type throughout with small-caps UI labels. Motion eased at 400–700ms.

Crisp Apple-native system UI: white surfaces, 0.5px hairline separators, single blue accent. Canvas orb is a multi-hue Gemini/Siri-inspired sphere: idle = soft breathing blue, listening = blue ring ripples with amplitude, thinking = hue-shifting blue→teal→indigo with dashed rotating ring, speaking = steady green-tinted amplitude pulse. Spring-eased entrances (cubic-bezier .32,.72,0,1). Continuous-corner radii and dynamic-type-like scale.

Terminal-aesthetic, zero-radius, 2px solid black borders everywhere. Avatar is block-character ASCII waveform (▁▂▃▅▇) inside a bordered box, frame-swapping between discrete ASCII states via setInterval (steps() timing — no easing). Listening shows bars rising in cyan block chars; thinking shows spinning pipe-slash-dash-backslash glyph; speaking shows orange block bars. Waveform in the dock is a live ASCII string of block chars. Hard color inversion on all hover states.

Frosted glass panels float over an animated pastel aurora background. The edge glow is a feathered periwinkle-lavender-mint bloom that breathes at idle, chases the perimeter while listening, hue-rotates while thinking, and amplitude-shimmers while speaking. The waveform is soft rounded bars. All surfaces use backdrop-filter blur and translucent white hairline borders. The demo auto-starts and demonstrates barge-in by snapping speaking→listening mid-turn.

True-black OLED surface with electric cyan and magenta neon accents. The edge glow is a 1px neon hairline that steps through hard-snap perimeter-chase (cyan while listening, magenta while thinking, rapid magenta flare while speaking). Waveform bars glow with CSS shadowBlur on canvas. All labels are monospace uppercase with 0.1em tracking. A scanline overlay sits above the frame. State label `[LISTENING]` etc. appears as a literal bracketed token in the status bar.

Cream warm-paper background with serif type (Palatino/Georgia) for all body and heading text and Avenir Next for UI labels. The edge glow is a soft clay-terracotta and sage wash that breathes slowly (500ms transitions). The waveform renders as a single organic ink-stroke SVG path that undulates with amplitude. Cards use thin 1px hairline rules instead of shadows. Buttons are quiet underlined pills. The editorial tone is unhurried throughout — no neon, no gradients.

Native iOS/macOS system UI aesthetic: white surfaces, 0.5px separators, SF Pro Text type, system blue accent, grouped inset list rows. The edge glow transitions through blue (idle/listening), a blue→teal→indigo shimmer (thinking), and system green amplitude pulse (speaking) — matching Siri-style multi-hue behavior. Waveform uses rounded rect bars in system blue or green. Buttons use continuous-corner feel with springy (cubic-bezier .32,.72,0,1) 280ms animations.

Bone-white background, 2px solid black borders on everything, hard 4px offset block-shadows, zero border-radius. The edge glow is a thick inset colored border that hard-steps (steps(1,end)) between states: accent blue blink at idle, hard-snap perimeter 4-step chase while listening, glitch-alternating blue/orange while thinking, rapid orange inset pulses while speaking, solid danger-red while muted. The waveform is a block-rect canvas bar chart. State is also printed as a literal `[THINKING...]` label. All text is uppercase monospace.

Frosted glass cards float over a slow-drifting aurora gradient. The orb is a radial periwinkle-to-mint sphere with a specular highlight and feathered bloom halo that ripples on mic input. All transitions ease at 240-400ms; card fan-out is a gentle stagger with scale+blur entrances. Suggestion chips are pill-shaped with translucent glass surfaces.

True-black canvas with a scanline overlay and cyan grid. The orb renders as cyan spectrum bars during listening and acid-lime bars during speaking, with a magenta churn for thinking. Cards glow with neon hairline borders; a scan-line sweeps the map card. All state transitions snap at 120-220ms. The composer uses JetBrains Mono throughout with monochrome uppercase labels.

Cream-toned canvas with light rule lines. The orb is an organic ink-blob that undulates slowly at idle, stretches laterally on mic input, bleeds sage-green during thinking, and pulses clay-terracotta during speaking. Cards use Iowan Old Style serif headings with hairline rule separators and generous line height. All animations ease at 400-700ms for an unhurried, literary feel.

Apple system UI aesthetic with white card surfaces, 0.5px separators, and a single blue accent. The orb is a Siri-inspired soft gradient sphere that shifts hue during thinking and turns green during speaking. The weather card uses a full blue gradient fill. iOS-native spring timing (cubic-bezier .32,.72,0,1) at 250-350ms. All cards use continuous-corner radii and elevation shadows only when floating.

Bone-white canvas with a 2px black grid and hard-offset block shadows. The orb is replaced by an ASCII block-character waveform box that swaps frames via setInterval with step() timing — bars at listening/speaking, a rotating glyph spinner at thinking, a slow blink at idle. Cards are square-cornered with 2px solid borders; buttons invert on hover. All transitions are instant (steps(1,end)). State is also printed as a bracketed label in the header.

Frosted glass terminal floating over a slow-drifting pastel aurora. The CLI prompt and monospace log sit inside a backdrop-blur surface with periwinkle/lavender/mint token colors. The avatar is a radial gradient orb with a specular highlight and animated bloom halo that ripples with mic amplitude during listening and churns during thinking. Wave bars animate in accent colors. All interaction — voice cycle, mute, attach chips, app card, suggestion pills — operates under the glassmorphism visual language with generous radii and springy 240–400ms eases.

True-black OLED cockpit with a cyan/magenta/acid-lime neon palette. The avatar is a canvas particle-field orb — rotating sparse cyan dots that expand with mic amplitude during listening, shift to magenta churn during thinking, and bloom lime-green during speaking. Wave bars glow with CSS box-shadow halos in state-matching colors. A scanline overlay and grid background reinforce the real-time machine aesthetic. All controls use 1px neon hairline borders that glow; state snaps are instant (120ms steps).

Cream, literary terminal rendered in Palatino/Georgia serif with a clay accent and sage secondary. The avatar is an SVG animated ink stroke — a hand-drawn-feeling sinusoidal path that breathes gently at idle, stretches with voice amplitude during listening, and flows left-to-right during speaking. Wave bars align to the bottom edge like a subtle paper graph. The app card is an inset editorial block with hairline rules instead of heavy borders. Slow 400–700ms ease-in-out transitions give the UI a page-turning quality.

Native Apple-style system UI: white surfaces, 0.5px hairline separators, system blue accent, SF Pro stack. The avatar is a Siri/Gemini-inspired conic-gradient ring that spins at different speeds per state (fast for listening, slow for thinking, medium for speaking) with an inner radial sphere that shifts hue. iOS-native spring easing (cubic-bezier .32 .72 0 1) at 250–350ms drives all state morphs. The mic↔send↔stop button uses colored system-blue/green/red fills with drop-shadow. Everything reads as a polished native app.

Zero-radius, 2px solid black borders, hard 4px offset block shadows, full JetBrains Mono throughout. The avatar IS the waveform — a 10-character field of Unicode block glyphs (▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█) that updates stepwise with mic amplitude during listening and TTS envelope during speaking, flatlines to ▁▁▁▁▁▁▁▁▁▁ when muted. A spinning | / — \ glyph marks thinking state. Buttons invert on hover (steps(1,end)). The title bar shows live state in a solid accent-colored block. Everything is exposed structure — no gradients, no blur, no spring.

Frosted glass panels with a slow-drifting pastel aurora background. The orb is a radial periwinkle-to-mint gradient sphere with a specular highlight and a bloom halo that ripples with mic amplitude. Cards animate in from depth with blur-to-crisp. All surfaces use backdrop-filter glass with 1px translucent white borders. Demo auto-starts and loops through idle, listening (waveform bars), thinking (hue rotation), and speaking (ripple rings) states.

True-black OLED cockpit with a canvas-rendered particle-field orb. Cyan particles orbit in z-layers, shifting to magenta on thinking and acid-lime on speaking. A neon grid underlay and scanline overlay set the tone. Monospaced labels, glowing cyan borders, and a startup scanline-fade animation. The orb ring class-swaps between cyan/magenta/lime depending on state; the particle density and speed change with amplitude.

Cream, literary paper aesthetic with a seriffed font and an SVG organic-blob avatar that continuously morphs via catmull-rom curve interpolation. The blob changes fill from terracotta (idle/listening) to sage green (thinking) and breathes in amplitude. Cards use a 2px clay-colored top-border and generous whitespace. Chips are quiet pills; composer has italic placeholder. Slow 400-700ms easing throughout with no hard cuts.

Apple-native system UI with a Siri-inspired multi-ring orb. The core sphere shifts from blue (idle/listening) to teal (thinking) to green (speaking) with CSS gradient transitions and animated outer rings that pulse in sync with state. Hairline 0.5px separators, continuous-corner radii, and a translucent frosted header. Smooth iOS-spring transitions at 250-350ms. The header subtitle label updates with the current state in a matching accent color.

Hard-edged terminal UI with a 2px solid-border avatar box containing a monospaced block-character waveform that frame-swaps between state-specific character sequences (bars for listening/speaking, spinner glyphs for thinking, static dashes for muted). Zero border-radius, hard-offset box-shadows, inverted header strip, uppercase monospaced labels everywhere. All state changes use steps(1,end) — snapping, never easing. Block-bar listening indicator with step-animated bars.

Frosted glass panels float over a slow-drifting pastel aurora background. The orb is a soft 3-stop radial sphere (periwinkle→lavender→mint) with a specular highlight and feathered bloom halo. Radial nodes are translucent glass pills with backdrop-blur. The ring opens with a springy scale-in animation; listening ripples the halo outward with simulated mic amplitude. All canvas rendering is CSS-only via box-shadow and gradients.

True-black OLED canvas with cyan and magenta neon accents and a scanline overlay. The orb hosts a canvas-rendered audio-waveform creature: radial spectrum bars in cyan for listening, magenta inner churn for thinking, bloom bars with HSL sweep for speaking, and sparse rotating particles for idle. Nodes are dark bordered boxes with neon glow on hover. State labels use uppercase monospace. Snappy 120–220ms transitions with hard state snaps.

Cream and terracotta editorial look with Palatino/Georgia serif for assistant prose and Avenir Next for UI labels. The orb renders a canvas-drawn organic ink-blob outline that undulates gently at idle, stretches with voice amplitude while listening, slowly ink-bleeds while thinking, and flows with a left-to-right stroke cadence while speaking. Radial nodes are quiet pills with 1px hairline borders. No harsh shadows — spacing and rules carry hierarchy.

Apple-native system light with SF Pro Text, 0.5px hairline separators, and grouped white surfaces on the system gray background. The orb is a conic-gradient multi-color sphere (blue→indigo→violet) that transitions to teal/green while speaking and cycles hue while thinking. Listening drives blue amplitude rings outward on a canvas. iOS spring easing (cubic-bezier .32,.72,0,1) throughout. Nodes are circular floating cards with subtle elevation shadows.

Bone-white surface, 2px solid black borders, hard 4px offset drop shadows — zero border radius. The orb contains a canvas-rendered block-character interface: [IDLE] with cursor blink, rising block-bar waveform (▁▂▃▅▇) in hard blue for listening, a spinning | / — \ glyph for thinking, and a symmetric envelope-shaped bar bloom in alternating black/blue for speaking (visibly distinct from listening). All text uppercase monospace. Stepwise transitions only — no easing, no blur.

Frosted glass panels float over a slow-drifting pastel aurora. The time rail uses translucent periwinkle nodes and backdrop-blur surfaces; the orb is a radial gradient sphere with a specular highlight and rippling halo that breathes at idle, stretches during listening, hue-rotates through thinking, and pulses in mint during speaking. Suggestion chips are pill-shaped with dashed lavender borders; the composer is a blurred glass row with a pill morph-button that spring-animates between mic, send, and stop glyphs.

True-black cockpit with electric cyan hairlines. The avatar is a <canvas> waveform creature: 8 spectrum bars rendered in cyan (listening), magenta (thinking), or mixed (speaking) with CSS glow drop-shadows. The rail is a dotted neon line; events use 1px glowing borders. All labels are monospaced uppercase; the status bar shows a blinking [LISTENING] / [MUTED] tag. The morph-button snaps instantly between states (no easing) matching the snappy 120ms timing spec.

Cream paper with a serif display font and clay-terracotta accent. The avatar is an organic <canvas> ink-stroke — a single undulating sine wave that breathes at idle, stretches with voice amplitude at listening, flows left-to-right while speaking, and dissolves into a slow rotating arc shimmer while thinking. The rail is a 1px rule with hairline time labels; event bubbles have soft 10px radii, minimal shadow, and generous line-height. All UI chrome uses Avenir Next; the composer has an italic serif placeholder.

Apple-native system UI: #F2F2F7 grouped background, 0.5px hairline separators, and a Siri-inspired blue radial orb. The orb uses CSS keyframe animations for each state — slow breathing at idle, rapid scale oscillation during listening (driven by a synthetic amplitude loop), hue-rotate shimmer for thinking, and a rhythmic bloom while speaking. Suggestion chips are system-pill style; the composer is a rounded inset row with SF system fonts throughout. A 'Live' green dot appears in the status bar while the mic is hot.

Bone-white with 2px solid black borders, hard 4px offset drop-shadows, and zero border-radius. The avatar is a bordered box containing 8 block bars that animate in discrete steps() — low static bars at idle, bars jumping to mic level at listening (cyan fill), one tall rotating bar cycling through columns at thinking (hazard orange), and amplitude-reactive bars at speaking. All text is uppercase monospace; status shows a blinking block cursor. Hover states invert colors instantly. The [LISTENING] / [MUTED] tags are solid color fills, not badges.

Frosted glass app window floating over a slow-drifting pastel aurora. The PTT orb is a radial periwinkle-to-mint gradient sphere with specular highlight and bloom halo; listening turns it teal with rippling state ring; thinking shows rotating particle dots; speaking pulsates the halo. All surfaces use backdrop-blur(24px) with translucent white hairline borders. Suggestion chips and assistant bubbles are glassmorphic pills on the surface-2 layer.

True-black OLED cockpit with electric cyan/magenta neon accents. The PTT button is a dark circle with a 1px neon hairline border that glows on hold; the avatar renders as a grid of neon frequency bars inside the orb — cyan while listening, magenta while thinking, cyan again while speaking. A scanline CSS overlay adds CRT texture. All labels use monospace uppercase with 0.12em tracking. State transitions snap instantly (steps(1)).

Cream-and-clay literary interface with serif body text (Palatino/Georgia). The PTT button is a solid clay-terracotta circle; the avatar renders as a single undulating organic wave inside the orb — Pi-style ink stroke that stretches with mic amplitude during listening and flows rhythmically during speaking. Thinking shows a slow ink-bleed radial shimmer. Typography is unhurried with generous line-height 1.6 and small-caps uppercase labels.

Native Apple system-light feel: white surfaces, 0.5px hairline separators, SF Pro font stack, system blue accent. The PTT button is a clean white circle with a conic-gradient Siri-ring that accelerates during listening; the avatar renders as radial amplitude rings plus 16 spoke-bars that react to simulated mic/TTS level — blue for listening, green for speaking. Transitions use iOS spring cubic-bezier. Cards use grouped inset style with elevation shadow.

High-contrast bone-white terminal aesthetic: 2px solid black borders on everything, zero border-radius, hard 4px offset drop-shadows, JetBrains Mono throughout. The PTT avatar is a bordered rectangle containing a live ASCII block-character waveform (▁▂▃▅▇) that steps between discrete frames — cyan bars during listening, orange-colored spinner glyphs (|/—\) during thinking. Hover on any interactive element inverts colors. State labels print literally as [LISTENING], [PROCESSING], [RX].

Frosted glass device floats over a slow-drifting pastel aurora. The avatar is a radial gradient orb with periwinkle-to-mint coloring, a specular highlight, and a feathered bloom halo that ripples outward on listening and pulses rhythmically on speaking. All transitions ease at 300–400ms with cubic-bezier spring. The single zen line fades upward between turns; the weather card slides in with a soft scale-in. Mute shows a red dot badge on the orb and kills all animation.

True-black OLED surface with cyan neon hairline borders and a scanline overlay. The avatar is a canvas-drawn ring of 36 spectrum bars that dance in cyan on listening, shift between cyan and magenta on thinking, and pulse densely on speaking. A live system clock in monospace runs in the header. All labels are ALL-CAPS monospace with 0.1em tracking. State transitions snap at 120ms. Mute inverts bars to a red crossed-out ring.

Cream paper surface with a clay accent rule at the top and a single serif typeface for all prose. The avatar is a canvas-drawn ink stroke — a Bezier wave that breathes slowly at idle, stretches with voice amplitude on listening, shimmers with a sage-to-clay gradient on thinking, and flows with heavier stroke weight on speaking. Transitions ease at 500–700ms for an unhurried, literary pace. The suggestion appears as a dashed underline link below a thin rule separator.

iOS-native grouped backgrounds, white cards with 0.5px hairline separators, and SF-style spring easing at 250–350ms. The avatar is a canvas-drawn Siri-style sphere with a multi-hue radial gradient and specular highlight; rings ripple outward with amplitude on listening, the hue slowly rotates through blue-teal-indigo on thinking, and amplitude-scaled rings pulse on speaking. Status bar with live clock. The weather card uses system blue and native rounded rects.

Bone-white background on a visible 20px grid with 2px solid black borders and hard 4px offset block-shadows on every element. The avatar is a bordered box containing 20 monospace block-character bars that update at stepped 80ms intervals — bars flash blue on listening, rotate as a spinner-pattern on thinking, and react to amplitude on speaking. State is printed as literal uppercase labels like [LISTENING]. All text is uppercase monospace. Hover inverts to black-on-white.

Frosted glass tiles float over a slow-drifting pastel aurora. The orb is a blurred radial gradient sphere (periwinkle→lavender→mint) with specular highlight and bloom halo. All four states animate with springy CSS keyframes; the aurora itself shifts hue on a 30s loop. App tiles lift and scale on activation. Chat bubbles use translucent accent gradients over the aurora backdrop.

True-black OLED cockpit with cyan neon hairline borders and a scanline body overlay. The orb is a live canvas element: idle shows sparse rotating cyan particles, listening renders RMS-reactive bar graphs, thinking emits a magenta particle churn, speaking drives TTS-amplitude bars with glow. All labels use monospace uppercase with 0.12em tracking. State snaps are instant — no spring.

Cream paper with serif body type and a clay accent. The orb is an SVG organic ink-blob whose outline morphs in four distinct shapes per state: idle breathes gently, listening stretches with mic amplitude, thinking drifts with slow hue oscillation, speaking pulses with TTS envelope. App tiles use thin hairline borders and quiet hover transitions. Cards feel like magazine pull-quotes.

Native iOS/macOS feel: white grouped surfaces, 0.5px separators, SF-style spring physics. The orb is a conic-gradient sphere cycling blue→teal→green with a gloss highlight. States map to ring ripple (listening), hue-rotate shimmer (thinking), green-dominant pulse (speaking). App tiles are white cards with subtle elevation. All typography uses the system-ui stack with dynamic-type-like sizing.

Bone-white with 2px black borders, hard drop-shadows, and zero radius on everything. All transitions are steps(1,end) — instant color inversions, no easing. State is also printed as a text label [LISTENING].

Frosted glass panels float over a slow-drifting pastel aurora. The orb is a radial periwinkle-to-mint sphere with a specular highlight and animated bloom halo — four CSS states: slow breathing idle, amplitude-reactive listening ripple, hue-rotating thinking, rhythmic speaking pulse. A WeatherCard React artifact populates the right workspace with Code/Preview tabs and refinement chips. A weather widget card appears inline in chat.

True-black cockpit with cyan and magenta neon borders, scanline overlay, and monospace labels. Cream paper background with serif body text and a single clay accent. Native iOS/macOS feel — white surfaces, 0.5px hairline separators, system blue accent. Bone-white background, 2px solid black borders everywhere, drop-shadow as hard 4px offsets, zero border-radius, all-caps monospace labels. Frosted glass panels over slow-drifting pastel aurora gradients. The avatar is a radial-gradient orb (periwinkle→lavender→mint) with a breathing halo ring and a bloom that ripples to mic amplitude. Memo rows have 1px neon accent trails, monospaced mono-uppercase labels, and a persistent scanline shimmer overlay. State changes are instant (120ms or steps(1,end)).

Memos are separated by thin hairline rules with generous vertical rhythm, serif body text, and small-caps Avenir labels — no box shadows, just spacing. All transitions run 400-700ms ease-in-out.

iOS-native system palette: grouped gray background, pure white cards, 0.5px hairline separators, SF Pro typeface. App card matches native grouped list inset style with system-blue actions.

Bone-white surface, 2px solid black borders on every element, hard 4px offset box-shadows, zero border-radius, full JetBrains Mono monospace. State labels are literal uppercase text tags like [LISTENING…] and [INTERRUPTED]. Hover = color inversion, click = shadow collapse + translate(2px,2px).

Frosted glass app window over a slow-drifting pastel aurora background. The companion Luna is a radial-gradient orb (periwinkle→lavender→mint) with a specular highlight and feathered bloom halo. Four avatar states are visually distinct: idle breathing scale pulse, listening with amplitude-reactive halo ripple driven by a sine+noise driver, thinking with a slow hue-rotation filter cycle, and speaking with a TTS-envelope scale pump. Weather app card, inline follow-up chip, partial→finalized voice turns with mic glyph, and a self-running demo cycle are all present.

True-black OLED surface with cyan/magenta neon accents and a scanline overlay. The companion NEXUS renders as a bordered particle field: 12 neon spectrum bars inside two counter-rotating ring frames. Bar heights animate at steps(4) speed per state — sparse idle sine, rapid noisy listening, magenta-tinted sine thinking, and TTS-envelope speaking with color swap to acid-lime eyes. State is also printed as a monospace uppercase label ([IDLE] etc.). The MIC·LISTENING indicator is a blinking dot plus uppercase mono label inside a 1px cyan-glowing border box. Mute dims the bars and shows a MIC·MUTED badge in danger red. All chip, card, and composer elements use tight 8px radii, hairline neon borders, and monospace font-mono throughout.

Warm cream editorial surface with serif prose, terracotta accent, and a Pi-style undulating ink stroke below the avatar. The companion Wren is an abstract ink clay blob with an organic border-radius morph on each state: slow undulation for idle, stretch-contract for listening, hue-shift shimmer for thinking, and vertical scale pump for speaking. A live SVG wave path (re-drawn each rAF frame) below the blob encodes state as amplitude and speed — idle is nearly flat, listening is noisy, thinking is slow sine, speaking is fast TTS envelope. The Listening… label uses a pulsing terracotta circle glyph. Serif body text, near-zero shadow, rule-based hierarchy, and slow ease-in-out transitions (400–700ms) differentiate this look from all others.

iOS-native system-light aesthetic: white surfaces, 0.5px hairline separators, SF Pro fonts, and a blue-dominant multi-ring orb (Siri-restrained). The Listening label is a quiet blue pill with a pulsing dot. iOS spring easing (cubic-bezier .32 .72 0 1) governs all transitions at 250–350ms. Card, chips, and composer follow Apple grouped-list conventions with continuous-corner radii.
